annotations.title: Progress of a delivery being booked in

description: How far a delivery has got in being applied to stock. A large delivery is applied item by item in the background, so its order keeps its old status until the work finishes — this is the only place that shows the real progress. Call it with the receiptId that receive_purchase_order returned, or the one get_purchase_order reports as still being received. Read `failures` seriously: those items did NOT get their stock and say why (the item was deleted, the outlet no longer exists, the supplier link was removed). Everything else on the delivery still landed, so the fix is per item, not a re-receive of the whole thing.
name: hub_get_receive_progress
title: Progress of a delivery being booked in
